title: Burberry perfume: My Burberry, My Burberry Black and the Her mini set compared
body:
Burberry's women's fragrances come in two families we stock: My Burberry, a soft, green floral, and Burberry Her, a fruity, berry-led line. My Burberry also has a richer sister, My Burberry Black. Here is every Burberry perfume we stock, with its notes and who each one suits.

My Burberry Eau de Parfum

My Burberry Eau de Parfum, in 50ml or 90ml, opens with sweet pea and bergamot, has geranium leaf, golden quince and freesia in the heart, and settles on patchouli with Damask and centifolia rose. Fresh, green and floral, an easy everyday scent for spring and autumn.

My Burberry Black Parfum

My Burberry Black Parfum, in 50ml or 90ml, is the richer, warmer version: jasmine, then peach nectar and candied rose, over amber and patchouli. Sweeter and deeper, it suits evenings and the colder months.

My Burberry or My Burberry Black? Choose the eau de parfum for a light, green floral; choose Black for a warm, sweet rose with amber.

The Burberry Her miniature set

The Burberry Women's Miniature Perfume Set holds four 5ml bottles from the Her family, 20ml in all:

  • Her Eau de Parfum (2 x 5ml): red berries and blackcurrant, jasmine and violet, over amber, musk and woods.
  • Her Eau de Toilette (5ml): green pear, strawberry and blackcurrant, peony and lily of the valley, over musk and cedarwood. Lighter and fresher.
  • Her London Dream Eau de Parfum (5ml): lemon and ginger, rose and peony, over musk and amber.

It is a good gift for someone who likes fruity florals, and an easy way to try the Her family.

Which Burberry perfume should you choose?

  • A fresh, green floral: My Burberry Eau de Parfum.
  • A warm rose with amber: My Burberry Black Parfum.
  • Fruity and berry-led: the Her miniature set.
  • A first bottle: the 50ml size of either My Burberry.

Other women's scents in a similar mood

These are different perfumes, not copies:

  • Chloé Rose Naturelle Intense Eau de Parfum (50ml): bergamot and neroli, rose and oakwood, over sandalwood and vanilla. Our Chloé perfume guide has more.
  • Lalique Perles Eau de Parfum (100ml): Bulgarian rose and orris over cashmere wood and tonka bean.
  • Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum (100ml): candied citrus, orange blossom and Madagascar vanilla, for anyone who likes the sweetness of My Burberry Black.

Good to know

  • Parfum or eau de parfum? Our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.
  • Buying a gift? See our mini perfume sets guide and perfume gift sets guide.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.
